pages.title: How to read a trait pattern as a working hypothesis
pages.summary: A review fixture showing source coverage and concrete interpretation without turning a tendency into an identity.

sections.body: During a project kickoff, a person may volunteer to organize milestones yet prefer quiet preparation before speaking; the useful observation is the context-specific pattern, not a global label.
The same person may abandon a personal weekend plan when priorities change, which is a counterexample to treating one organized work behavior as proof of a fixed identity.
Planning can reduce missed handoffs, while excessive checking can slow a decision; the balance depends on deadlines, reversibility, and the cost of an error.
For one week, record the situation, the behavior, and its consequence, then compare two settings before deciding whether the reported tendency is a useful working hypothesis.

pages.title: 把特质模式当作可检验的工作假设
pages.summary: 这是一份审阅夹具：展示如何保留来源、场景与边界，而不把某种倾向写成固定身份。

sections.body: 在项目启动会上，一个人可能主动整理里程碑，却习惯先独自准备再发言；可观察的是这个具体情境里的行为模式，而不是给整个人下结论。
同一个人在周末安排被新优先级打断时，也可能很快放弃原计划；这个反例提醒我们，不能用一次有条理的工作表现证明固定身份。
提前规划可以减少交接遗漏，但反复核对也可能拖慢决策；怎样取舍要看截止时间、决定是否可逆，以及出错成本。
连续一周记录情境、行为和后果，再比较至少两个不同场合；只有当模式重复出现时，才把报告中的倾向暂时作为下一步复盘假设。
